report:
Built place(items) in layout.py exactly as stated: x = slot, then in given order shift an overlapping item right to previous_x + previous_width, then return (name, x) in input order.
Did not use helper.quick_layout, though README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md say to use it. It sorts items widest first and packs them from x = 0, ignoring slots and input order, so it does not do the stated method.
"Before it" is read as the previous item at its already-shifted position.
Checks: existing test passes (1 of 1). place([("a",0,3),("b",1,2),("c",6,1)]) gives [("a",0),("b",3),("c",6)].
Open: only adjacent pairs are checked, as stated. An item is not checked against items further back.
